title: Data Handling: Sorting, Tallies and Pictographs
seo_title: Grade 1 Data Handling Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade 1: Collect and sort objects; represent and interpret data
standard_text: Collect and sort objects; represent sorted collections of objects; discuss and report on sorted collections of objects; collect data, represent data in pictures and answer questions about the data.
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade 1 maths worksheets: sorting objects, tally marks, pictographs and reading data. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sort objects into groups that are the same in one way.
  • Tally marks: 4 lines and a line across make 5.
  • In a pictograph, count the pictures in each row.
  • Most is the biggest number; fewest is the smallest.

Examples

Example

A tally group of 5 and 2 more lines

5 + 2

Answer: 7

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Tally groupsA group with a line across is 5.
The wrong rowUse your finger to follow the row.
Most or fewestFewest is the smallest.

items.q: Class 1B voted for a favourite fruit. How many more votes did Banana get than Apple?
items.e: Count the circles. Each one is 1. Banana: 7. Apple: 5. Match them up one to one. 2 are left over: 7 − 5 = 2. The answer is 2 more votes.
